title: Pragmatics-Based Framing Vaccination Against Emergent Misalignment

original_idea.body:
# Pragmatics-Based Framing Vaccination Against EM

**Problem:** We don't know which pragmatic features of protective framing carry the EM-prevention effect.

**Direction:** Decompose framing into manipulable features and run factorial LoRA fine-tunes varying one feature at a time.

**Why it matters:** Lets curators apply the active ingredient deliberately. Cheap LoRA.

**Relevant context:** arXiv:2502.17424; arXiv:2604.25891.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Finding the active ingredient in a framing intervention that blocks EM lets curators apply it deliberately.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Factorial LoRA fine-tunes varying framing features; guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused factorial; needs several fine-tunes per feature condition.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Cheap LoRA, public data; weak lab incentive on framing-pragmatics follow-up.

low_compute.reasoning: Several small LoRA fine-tunes on one GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Framing-prevents-EM is known; decomposing which feature carries it may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Framing effect known; pragmatic-feature decomposition may be open.
